```python
import pygame
import random
import sys

TILE = 10
GRID = 80
BAR = 84
WIDTH = GRID * TILE
HEIGHT = GRID * TILE + BAR

MONSTERS = [
    ("Slime", 10, (190, 70, 70)),
    ("Bat", 16, (160, 80, 190)),
    ("Skeleton", 25, (210, 210, 210)),
    ("Ghost", 38, (130, 170, 230)),
    ("Dragon", 60, (230, 130, 50)),
]

WALL, FLOOR, DOOR = 1, 0, 2


class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        pygame.init()
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
        pygame.display.set_caption("Tower of the Sorcerer - Roguelike")
        self.font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 26)
        self.big = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 64)
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        self.reset()

    def reset(self):
        self.level = 1
        self.maxhp = 100
        self.hp = 100
        self.dead = False
        self.msg = "Reach the green door. WASD to move."
        self.last_monster = None
        self.gen_level()

    def gen_level(self):
        g = [[WALL] * GRID for _ in range(GRID)]
        sx, sy = 2, 2
        dx, dy = GRID - 3, GRID - 3
        # Carve a guaranteed path from start to door (random walk, always progressing)
        x, y = sx, sy
        g[y][x] = FLOOR
        while (x, y) != (dx, dy):
            if x != dx and (y == dy or random.random() < 0.5):
                x += 1 if x < dx else -1
            else:
                y += 1 if y < dy else -1
            g[y][x] = FLOOR
        # Open random extra floor areas
        for yy in range(GRID):
            for xx in range(GRID):
                if g[yy][xx] == WALL and random.random() < 0.30:
                    g[yy][xx] = FLOOR
        g[dy][dx] = DOOR
        self.g = g
        self.px, self.py = sx, sy
        # Place monsters and chests on floor tiles away from start/door
        spots = [(xx, yy) for yy in range(GRID) for xx in range(GRID)
                 if g[yy][xx] == FLOOR and (xx, yy) != (sx, sy)
                 and abs(xx - sx) + abs(yy - sy) > 3]
        random.shuffle(spots)
        self.monsters = {}
        n_mon = min(len(spots), 8 + self.level * 2)
        kinds = MONSTERS[:min(len(MONSTERS), 1 + self.level)]
        for _ in range(n_mon):
            if not spots:
                break
            xx, yy = spots.pop()
            name, base, col = random.choice(kinds)
            self.monsters[(xx, yy)] = (name, base + (self.level - 1) * 5, col)
        self.chests = set()
        for _ in range(min(len(spots), 3)):
            xx, yy = spots.pop()
            self.chests.add((xx, yy))

    def move(self, ddx, ddy):
        if self.dead:
            return
        nx, ny = self.px + ddx, self.py + ddy
        if not (0 <= nx < GRID and 0 <= ny < GRID):
            return
        tile = self.g[ny][nx]
        if tile == WALL:
            return
        key = (nx, ny)
        if key in self.monsters:
            name, mhp, col = self.monsters.pop(key)
            self.hp -= mhp
            self.last_monster = (name, mhp)
            self.msg = "Fought %s! -%d HP" % (name, mhp)
            if self.hp <= 0:
                self.hp = 0
                self.dead = True
                self.msg = "You died to %s. Press R to restart." % name
                return
        elif key in self.chests:
            self.chests.discard(key)
            heal = random.randint(20, 30)
            self.hp = min(self.maxhp, self.hp + heal)
            self.msg = "Treasure chest! +%d HP" % heal
        elif tile == DOOR:
            self.level += 1
            self.gen_level()
            self.msg = "Level %d! Monsters are stronger." % self.level
            return
        self.px, self.py = nx, ny

    def nearby(self):
        res = []
        for ddx, ddy in ((0, -1), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (1, 0)):
            k = (self.px + ddx, self.py + ddy)
            if k in self.monsters:
                res.append(self.monsters[k])
        return res

    def draw(self):
        self.screen.fill((24, 24, 34))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, (44, 44, 66), (0, 0, WIDTH, BAR))
        hpc = (90, 220, 90) if self.hp > 30 else (230, 90, 90)
        self.screen.blit(self.font.render(
            "HP: %d/%d    Level: %d" % (self.hp, self.maxhp, self.level), True, hpc), (12, 6))
        adj = self.nearby()
        if adj:
            info = "   ".join("%s (HP %d)" % (n, h) for n, h, c in adj)
            t = self.font.render("Encountered: " + info, True, (255, 215, 120))
        elif self.last_monster:
            t = self.font.render("Last monster: %s (HP %d)" % self.last_monster,
                                 True, (200, 200, 210))
        else:
            t = self.font.render("Encountered: none", True, (150, 150, 160))
        self.screen.blit(t, (12, 32))
        self.screen.blit(self.font.render(self.msg, True, (180, 220, 255)), (12, 58))
        oy = BAR
        for yy in range(GRID):
            for xx in range(GRID):
                t = self.g[yy][xx]
                r = pygame.Rect(xx * TILE, oy + yy * TILE, TILE, TILE)
                col = (72, 72, 86) if t == WALL else (198, 188, 168)
                pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, col, r)
                if t == DOOR:
                    pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, (60, 200, 90), r.inflate(-2, -2))
        for (xx, yy), (n, h, c) in self.monsters.items():
            pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, c,
                             (xx * TILE + 1, oy + yy * TILE + 1, TILE - 2, TILE - 2))
        for (xx, yy) in self.chests:
            pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, (235, 195, 60),
                             (xx * TILE + 1, oy + yy * TILE + 1, TILE - 2, TILE - 2))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, (50, 130, 245),
                         (self.px * TILE + 1, oy + self.py * TILE + 1, TILE - 2, TILE - 2))
        if self.dead:
            s = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            s.fill((0, 0, 0, 170))
            self.screen.blit(s, (0, 0))
            go = self.big.render("GAME OVER", True, (235, 80, 80))
            self.screen.blit(go, (WIDTH // 2 - go.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT // 2 - 60))
            rt = self.font.render("Press R to restart", True, (240, 240, 240))
            self.screen.blit(rt, (WIDTH // 2 - rt.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT // 2 + 20))

    def run(self):
        while True:
            for e in pygame.event.get():
                if e.type == pygame.QUIT:
                    pygame.quit()
                    sys.exit()
                if e.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                    if e.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                        pygame.quit()
                        sys.exit()
                    if e.key == pygame.K_r and self.dead:
                        self.reset()
                    elif not self.dead:
                        if e.key in (pygame.K_w, pygame.K_UP):
                            self.move(0, -1)
                        elif e.key in (pygame.K_s, pygame.K_DOWN):
                            self.move(0, 1)
                        elif e.key in (pygame.K_a, pygame.K_LEFT):
                            self.move(-1, 0)
                        elif e.key in (pygame.K_d, pygame.K_RIGHT):
                            self.move(1, 0)
            self.draw()
            pygame.display.flip()
            self.clock.tick(30)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    Game().run()
```

import random
import tkinter as tk

GRID = 80
CELL = 10
WALL, FLOOR = 0, 1


class Game:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("Tower of the Sorcerer - Roguelike")
        self.info = tk.Label(root, font=("Courier", 12), justify="left", anchor="w")
        self.info.pack(fill="x")
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(root, width=GRID * CELL, height=GRID * CELL,
                                bg="#e8e0d0", highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack()
        for k in "wasd":
            root.bind(k, self.on_key)
            root.bind(k.upper(), self.on_key)
        root.bind("r", self.on_key)
        root.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: root.destroy())
        self.new_run()

    def new_run(self):
        self.hp = 100
        self.level = 1
        self.msg = "W/A/S/D move | R restart | Reach the green door"
        self.build_level()

    def build_level(self):
        g = [[WALL] * GRID for _ in range(GRID)]
        for y in range(1, GRID - 1):
            for x in range(1, GRID - 1):
                if random.random() < 0.70:
                    g[y][x] = FLOOR
        # Carve a guaranteed path from start to door so a valid route always exists.
        sx, sy = 1, 1
        self.door = (GRID - 2, GRID - 2)
        px, py = sx, sy
        g[py][px] = FLOOR
        path = {(px, py)}
        while (px, py) != self.door:
            dx = (self.door[0] > px) - (self.door[0] < px)
            dy = (self.door[1] > py) - (self.door[1] < py)
            if dx and dy:
                if random.random() < 0.5:
                    px += dx
                else:
                    py += dy
            elif dx:
                px += dx
            else:
                py += dy
            g[py][px] = FLOOR
            path.add((px, py))
        self.g = g
        self.px, self.py = sx, sy
        # Monsters and chests are never placed on the guaranteed path.
        spots = [(x, y) for y in range(1, GRID - 1) for x in range(1, GRID - 1)
                 if g[y][x] == FLOOR and (x, y) not in path]
        random.shuffle(spots)
        n_mon = min(15 + 5 * self.level, len(spots))
        self.monsters = {}
        for i in range(n_mon):
            x, y = spots[i]
            self.monsters[(x, y)] = random.randint(5, 15) + 5 * self.level
        rest = spots[n_mon:]
        self.chests = set(rest[:15])
        self.draw()

    def on_key(self, e):
        ch = e.char.lower()
        if ch == "r":
            self.new_run()
            return
        d = {"w": (0, -1), "a": (-1, 0), "s": (0, 1), "d": (1, 0)}.get(ch)
        if not d or self.hp <= 0:
            return
        nx, ny = self.px + d[0], self.py + d[1]
        if not (0 <= nx < GRID and 0 <= ny < GRID) or self.g[ny][nx] == WALL:
            return
        if (nx, ny) in self.monsters:
            mhp = self.monsters.pop((nx, ny))
            self.hp -= mhp
            self.msg = "Encountered Monster [HP %d | ATK %d]: lost %d HP" % (mhp, mhp, mhp)
            if self.hp <= 0:
                self.hp = 0
                self.msg = "You died! Press R to restart."
                self.draw()
                return
        elif (nx, ny) in self.chests:
            self.chests.discard((nx, ny))
            heal = random.randint(20, 30)
            self.hp += heal
            self.msg = "Treasure chest: restored %d HP" % heal
        elif (nx, ny) == self.door:
            self.level += 1
            self.msg = "Entered level %d. Monsters grow stronger!" % self.level
            self.build_level()
            return
        self.px, self.py = nx, ny
        self.draw()

    def draw(self):
        c = self.canvas
        c.delete("all")
        for y in range(GRID):
            row = self.g[y]
            for x in range(GRID):
                if row[x] == WALL:
                    c.create_rectangle(x * CELL, y * CELL, (x + 1) * CELL, (y + 1) * CELL,
                                       fill="#4a4a4a", width=0)
        for (x, y), mhp in self.monsters.items():
            c.create_rectangle(x * CELL, y * CELL, (x + 1) * CELL, (y + 1) * CELL,
                               fill="#cc2222", width=0)
        for (x, y) in self.chests:
            c.create_rectangle(x * CELL, y * CELL, (x + 1) * CELL, (y + 1) * CELL,
                               fill="#e6b422", width=0)
        dx, dy = self.door
        c.create_rectangle(dx * CELL, dy * CELL, (dx + 1) * CELL, (dy + 1) * CELL,
                           fill="#22aa44", width=0)
        c.create_rectangle(self.px * CELL, self.py * CELL, (self.px + 1) * CELL,
                           (self.py + 1) * CELL, fill="#2255ee", width=0)
        self.info.config(text="HP: %d | Level: %d | Monsters: %d | Chests: %d\n%s"
                         % (self.hp, self.level, len(self.monsters), len(self.chests), self.msg))


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    Game(root)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
